theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.CrossingFamily.degenerate_at_zero
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (gam x : ℝ), ATK.CrossingFamily.quarticG 0 gam x = (x ^ 2 + gam ^ 2) ^ 2

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.CrossingFamily.factorization
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (lam gam x : ℝ), ATK.CrossingFamily.quarticG lam gam x = ((x - lam) ^ 2 + gam ^ 2) * ((x + lam) ^ 2 + gam ^ 2)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.CrossingFamily.quarticG_nonneg
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (lam gam x : ℝ), 0 ≤ ATK.CrossingFamily.quarticG lam gam x

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.Dichotomy.all_critical_iff_no_noncritical

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.Dichotomy.not_both

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.Involution.Pminus_idem
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (S : ℝ), S ^ 2 = 1 → ATK.Involution.Pminus S ^ 2 = ATK.Involution.Pminus S

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.Involution.Pplus_add_Pminus
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (S : ℝ), ATK.Involution.Pplus S + ATK.Involution.Pminus S = 1

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.Involution.Pplus_idem
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (S : ℝ), S ^ 2 = 1 → ATK.Involution.Pplus S ^ 2 = ATK.Involution.Pplus S

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.Involution.Pplus_mul_Pminus
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (S : ℝ), S ^ 2 = 1 → ATK.Involution.Pplus S * ATK.Involution.Pminus S = 0

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.Involution.doubled_idempotent_minus
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing α] (S : α), S ^ 2 = 1 → (1 - S) * (1 - S) = 2 * (1 - S)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.Involution.doubled_idempotent_plus
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing α] (S : α), S ^ 2 = 1 → (1 + S) * (1 + S) = 2 * (1 + S)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.Involution.product_zero
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing α] (S : α), S ^ 2 = 1 → (1 + S) * (1 - S) = 0

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.Multiplicity.cofactor_nonzero
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Field α] {h u : α → α} (a : α), h a ≠ 0 → u a ≠ 0 → u a * h a ≠ 0

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.Multiplicity.factor_preserved
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Field α] {h u F : α → α} (a : α) (m : ℕ),   (∀ (z : α), F z = (z - a) ^ m * h z) → ∀ (z : α), u z * F z = (z - a) ^ m * (u z * h z)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.Multiplicity.zero_iff_of_nonzero_factor
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Field α] {F G u : α → α} (a : α), (∀ (z : α), G z = u z * F z) → u a ≠ 0 → (F a = 0 ↔ G a = 0)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.PairSum.pair_sum_symmetric_three_doubled
